description: This file defines the CharacterRenderer class responsible for rendering special characters to RTF format within the MigraDoc document processing library.

classes.name: CharacterRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a specific character or symbol to RTF, handling various symbol types and their corresponding RTF control codes or hex values.

methods.name: CharacterRenderer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the renderer with a DocumentObject and RtfDocumentRenderer.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Method that performs the rendering of the character to RTF, handling different symbol types and character values.
